# The chronology

<!-- Generated from in-app Help; do not edit by hand. -->

One patient's events in time order, for a post-incident review, ready to print or download.

## What is on the screen

1. Find a patient. Search by name or UMRN to build their chronology.
2. Generated. When it was built. Synthetic demo data, not a clinical record.
3. Patients on the board. Everyone with a record, A to Z by surname. Show more lists more; search finds anyone else.
4. Open a chronology. Choose a person to open their events in time order, with Print and CSV.
5. What it holds. Records, the audit trail where your desk may see it, and this session's log. Times are as recorded, never worked out.

In BedChart, open Help and choose Show me around this screen to see each part lit in turn.

_Prototype on synthetic data. Not for real patients._
